# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Mid-fifties to around sixty years old  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044), [v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Single  <sub>[v1 c6 P36](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0036), [v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
- **Role:** Housekeeper and farmer at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009)</sub>

## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin woman with distinct angles and no curves. Her dark hair shows gray streaks and is twirled into a tight little knot behind, held aggressively by two wire hairpins. Though her face reflects narrow experience and a rigid conscience, a slight twitching or line around her mouth occasionally reveals a hidden sense of humor. Over time, her face softens, though her dark hair grows grayer and her eyesight weakens, necessitating glasses.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c16 P71](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0071), [v1 c30 P0](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0000), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v1 c36 P26](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0026), [v1 c36 P31](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0031)_

## Personality

Marilla is a woman of rigid conscience, narrow experience, and strict discipline who values order, tidiness, and practical duty above all else. She dislikes emotional displays and vanity, frequently expressing a disdain for flowery language, imaginings, or romantic nonsense. Beneath her stern and curt exterior lies a deep capacity for affection and a latent sense of humor. Once she makes up her mind on a course of action, she remains steadfast and persistent. Over the years of raising Anne, her nature softens into a warmer, more openly loving maternity.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c1 P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019), [v1 c4 P10](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0010), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c9 P12](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0012), [v1 c10 P50](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0050), [v1 c11 P8](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0008), [v1 c13 P11](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0011), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c38 P46](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0046)_

## History

Marilla Cuthbert lived a quiet, secluded life at Green Gables with her shy brother Matthew. When Matthew grew older, they decided to adopt an orphan boy from Nova Scotia to help on the farm. Through a miscommunicated message, an eleven-year-old orphan girl named Anne Shirley was sent instead. Although Marilla initially intended to send Anne back, she relented out of pity and a sense of duty, agreeing to raise her. Over the next several years, Marilla navigated the challenges of raising an imaginative, talkative, and impulse-driven child, continually trying to curb Anne's romantic excesses while secretly developing a deep, maternal affection for her. She suffered severe headaches and eventually faced failing eyesight, being warned by an oculist to give up reading and fine sewing to avoid total blindness. Following Matthew's sudden death from a heart attack, Marilla considered selling Green Gables because she could no longer manage the property alone. However, Anne decided to forego her college scholarship to stay in Avonlea and teach locally to support her. Marilla subsequently invited her widowed friend, Rachel Lynde, to move into Green Gables, allowing Anne to attend Redmond College after all.
